adjudication.rationale: The migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` creates `embeddable_hosts` with `host` and `category_id` but adds no indexes or constraints. The runtime lookup used for every embed request is `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` which executes `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (see `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`), and both `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` and `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` now call `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`. With no index on `lower(host)` (or even on `host`), this becomes an unindexed full-table scan. Also, there is no uniqueness validation/constraint on `host`, so duplicates can exist; in that case `.first` returns an arbitrary matching row, which can map an embed URL to the wrong category (`TopicEmbed.import` uses `eh.try(:category_id)`). Finally, there is no FK on `category_id`, so deleting a category can leave orphaned `embeddable_hosts` rows pointing at nothing.
